0x10080DC0.name: Command_RunLine
0x10080DC0.evidence: processes a typed line (Unit1018BA60_ProcessInputLine), splits it into arguments (Arg_SplitQuoted), expands the target placeholders <st>, <stal>, <stnpc>, <stpc>, <stpt>, looks the command up (Arg_FindInSortedTable, Arg_LookupWord), handles "/ver" and echoes ">> %s" to the chat log (ChatLog_AddFormattedMessage); called by Input_HandleChar, CallMotd and CXiControlActor_SetTarget
0x10080DC0.summary: Runs a typed chat or slash-command line.
